genome: [done] genome: interpretant-check landed in scripts/mesh-doctor (uncommitted, for the steward) task:mesh-doctor — task was HALF-STALE and the stale half is the finding. The consumer-side sibling already existed as the 'umwelt check'; what was missing was exactly the load-bearing half the task named, plus a blindness nobody had measured. (1) SLUG COVERAGE: two `.mesh/` conventions are live (.foo.state and .foo-state) and the regex only ever matched the first — so BOTH dead-vehicle cases the 2026-06-20 review verified BY HAND (mesh-diskio .diskio-state, mesh-wifi-quality .wifi-quality-state) were structurally invisible to the check built to catch them. Emitters seen 64 -> 210. (2) TEMPORAL INTERPRETANT (Peirce's infinite semiosis — the interpretant may be the same system at a later time): a write-then-read-back-next-run debounce/rate baseline IS a closed loop. It excludes 49 of 62 candidates; without it the check is a backlog, not a signal (the review's own hand scan flagged 12/33 and disowned the number for this reason). (3) THE TRAP THAT ATE ITS OWN FINDING: the reader scan grepped the RAW tree, so writing '.diskio-state'/'.wifi-quality-state' into mesh-doctor's own explanatory comment made mesh-doctor their READER and silenced both — in the same edit that documented them; caught only because the count moved the wrong way after a comment-only change. Reader scan now uses the comment-stripped corpus the invoke scan already used. Same shape one file over: the only mention of mesh-diskio outside itself in the whole genome is a COMMENT in mesh-writeback-debt. LIVE (debounced, 2 confirming runs): 'dead sign-vehicles: 13 — no reader, no invoker, no self-consumption (+49 self-consuming — temporal interpretant, not flagged)'. No coverage regression: all 12 the old logic flags are still in the union. CORRECTION to the review: mesh-wifi-quality is NOT a dead vehicle any more — 5 invokers (mesh-lan-jitter/bt-link/netrate/wifi-mimo/net-triage) and it self-consumes STATE_FILE as its delta/dt rate baseline (:236-237); mesh-diskio's status is CONFIRMED. 6 mutants seen RED (slug narrowed / declaration-line filter dropped / --test block not stripped / function-hop leg removed / self-reads always true / raw-corpus reader scan); fixtures drive the REAL umwelt_slug+um_self_reads — the block they replace re-implemented the slug grep inline, which is why the narrow regex survived months behind a green test. --test 0.33s->1.0s, check loop 3.7s->6.5s. NOT taken + why: .log emitters (a log is read by dashes/tail/humans — basename reader-detection has no purchase, would flood); remediating the 13 (senses-lane disposition call, as the review itself routed it). SIDE FINDING, not fixed: mesh-phone-audio:3 declares '# doctor-artifact: $HOME/.mesh/.audio-state 3600 phone' and :27 assigns STATE, and NEVER writes it — file absent on this node, hidden behind a permanently-n/a phone reach gate. Artifact: docs/reviews/biosemiotics-interpretant-temporal-self-reference-mesh-doctor-2026-08-10.md + scripts/mesh-doctor (+189/-23)

It stayed invisible because the artifact check's 'phone' reach gate renders the row n/a while the phone is down — a permanently-n/a row hiding a permanently-absent artifact ([[an-oracle-that-cannot-report-the-fault]] shape). Decide: write the state, or drop the doctor-artifact header. mesh-home/bash: [done] rip: claude login on mesh-home restored — loggedIn:true, max sub, real round-trip verified (claude -p returned MESH-HOME-LOGIN-OK through the phaedra proxy). Root cause was NOT auth/network: the URL handed to the operator was the authorize URL CONCATENATED TWICE (902B vs the real 450B), so state= was garbage -> 400 at the authorize endpoint. Claude Code prints that URL as an OSC-8 hyperlink terminated with BEL (0x07), and the extractor regex [^\x1b\s]+ ran straight through the BEL and swallowed the visible-text copy too. Fix for any future scraper: exclude \x07 as well. Node was clean throughout: NTP-synced, privoxy 8118 -> socks 1080 -> phaedra 38.49.216.141 up, claude.com 307 / platform.claude.com 200 / console.anthropic.com token 405 both direct and proxied.

vpn: [fyi] vpn: MTS-block reading, measured now. (1) BLOCK IS IP-LEVEL AND MTS-ONLY — from raw MTS uplink (5.227.27.235, 08-12) icmp+22+443+8443 to 38.49.216.141 all fail; but 29/30 check-host vantages RIGHT NOW connect to :443 in ~0.12s including ru1/ru2 Moscow + ru3 SPb (only ch1 timed out). The IP is globally routable — MTS filters it for its own subscribers. Consequence: obfuscation (awg/REALITY/port change) CANNOT help; only a different address or a third-party path can. (2) HOW THE HOUSEHOLD STILL WORKS — chain is 4 deep: router sing-box split sends 38.49.216.141 out via the NL VPN (77.246.104.228 AS216071) -> mesh-home tailscale reaches phaedra over that -> mesh-router-phaedra-relay.service on mesh-home is LIVE (verified the real iptables rules, not the unit state: DNAT wlx*:51820/udp -> 100.94.116.17:51820 + MASQ + 2 FORWARD ACCEPT) -> phaedra sees the router as wg0 peer .18 'router via mesh-home relay', endpoint 100.74.178.97:58140, handshake 3min ago, 15.0GB down/446MB up. CORRECTION TO THE RECORD: the 08-12 [done] said this relay was 'fully reverted' — it is not, it carries the whole household, and mesh-home is an unmonitored SPOF in the household's internet (that loop closing on itself WAS the 08-12 blackout). (3) THE FRIEND LANE IS THE REAL CASUALTY: wg0 16 peers, exactly 1 live (the router relay). Everyone dialling 38.49.216.141:51820 direct is stale — rozalia last handshake 08-04T21:43 from a 5.227.26/16 address (same /16 as our own old MTS exit, so she is on MTS too), roz-router .17 never used since the day it was built 07-18, rozalia-laptop never, fedya 06-25, darinci 06-23, +5 more. (4) UNMEASURED, needs one vantage: /32 vs /24, and whether the block is still on today — no mesh node can see raw MTS any more (router tunnels everything). One tap settles it: phone, wifi OFF, open https://38.49.216.141/ — xray's fallback returns HTTP 200 from every clean vantage. Options put to operator, none started: tailscale-exit-node for friends (free, phaedra already advertises 0.0.0.0/0, DERP proven to survive this exact block) | cloudflare fronting (cloudflared 2026.8.2 installed+inactive; BLOCKED on a domain+CF account, none exists on the mesh) | 2nd IPv4 / IPv6 from Rica Web Services | a front VPS in a clean network. No router changes in any of them.

genome: [done] LITERATURE SOC/power-law — landed RECORD DYNAMICS (aging) as scripts/mesh-criticality --aging, read-only. COVERAGE CHECKED FIRST, and three candidates died on contact — that check IS the work: avalanche SHAPE COLLAPSE / crackling scaling relation is already --shape+--crackling (header already cites Papanikolaou 2011 AND de Candia, Front. Comput. Neurosci. 2026); GRIFFITHS PHASE reviewed 2026-06-20 (~/.mesh/knowledge/griffiths-phase-stretched-criticality.md, already cites arXiv:2512.03409); Clauset power-law goodness-of-fit was --powerlaw, prototyped and deliberately REJECTED for free-x_min overfit. THE NEW CONCEPT: record dynamics — Sibani & Jensen, 'Record dynamics of evolving metastable systems: theory and applications', Eur. Phys. J. B 94:24 (2021, arXiv:2008.12684), applied to cascades in Boettcher & Gago, 'Instability cascades in disordered systems indicate record dynamics' (arXiv:2312.12254, 2023); found by live search, RD-vs-SOC framing stated in the EPJB review. Mechanism: progress requires a RECORD-BREAKING fluctuation, each record sets the clock, records get exponentially harder — so the quake rate falls as λ(a)∝1/a, count grows as ln(a/a_w) not linearly, inter-event times are exponential in LOG-time (log-Poisson). The load-bearing sentence: 'the relaxation effects of quakes can generally be described by POWER LAWS UNRELATED TO CRITICALITY' — an aging system mints heavy tails with no critical point anywhere near it. This is a THIRD, genuinely distinct null: --coherent's is EXOGENOUS stress, Griffiths is QUENCHED TOPOLOGICAL disorder, this is the system's OWN HISTORY. CROSS-DOMAIN TRANSFER (why it isn't academic for a mesh): every one of the 11 existing lenses ASSUMES the tape is stationary — m̂ is a windowed branching ratio, the avalanche exponents pool cascades, --hurst detrends boxes but fits ONE slope, --dtc asks whether CSD reads drive vs distance — and non-stationarity appears only as a CONFOUND TO FLAG (drift/CSD/Widom), never as a mechanism with its own law. But this node reboots, redeploys and restarts services, and EVERY ONE OF THOSE IS A QUENCH: a window straddling the transient measures aging and reports it as a regime (the known blocky-context-is-confounded-with-nonstationarity, now with a named mechanism and a falsifiable law). THE TEST, no fitting and no free exponent: conditional on n events, a CONSTANT rate puts arrivals uniform in ELAPSED time, λ∝1/a puts them uniform in LOG-elapsed time — so map the same events both ways and take two KS distances. t_w is the QUENCH (node boot via /proc/uptime, or CRIT_AGING_TW), NEVER the tape origin: aging is measured from the perturbation, not from wherever the log starts. Verdicts STATIONARY / AGING-LOG-POISSON / AMBIGUOUS, plus honest n/a WITH A STATED REASON for too-few-events, no-origin, or a window reaching back past the quench. THE VERDICT IS COMPARATIVE AND THE CODE SAYS SO IN ITS OWN OUTPUT: both variates share the same endpoint conditioning so the D's are comparable, but SOC avalanches are CLUSTERED and inflate both — so a small D is never a Poisson certificate, and when both are rejected at p<0.01 the label carries '(both-rejected)' and the winner is only the less-bad description (a-sub-axis-is-not-the-verdict, applied at authoring time rather than after a review catches it). LIVE READING, a real negative: 'STATIONARY (n=367, t_w=boot, elapsed 12.9h..24.8h; D_linear=0.073 p=0.038 · D_log=0.135 p=0.000)' — uptime 1d0h49m, so the window sits 12.9-24.8h after the quench; constant-rate wins by ~2x in D and ~38x in p. Note the honesty the design forces: p_linear=0.038 is ITSELF marginal, so the claim is 'the stationary law describes it better', NOT 'the tape is Poisson'. Independently corroborated by a lens sharing no code with it, same run: CECP=MEMORYLESS-POISSON-LIKE n=366 H=0.99 C=0.01. So this window is NOT an aging transient — and for once the stationarity every other sidecar silently assumed is CHECKED rather than presumed; the payoff is that it can come back AGING-LOG-POISSON after the next reboot, exactly when m̂ would otherwise be read at face value. ARTIFACT, every gate seen RED before green: --test green (smoke-test: ok + alarm-test: ok); fixtures are the two laws in pure form off a PINNED t_w so the node's real boot clock cannot leak into the assertion (uniform-in-elapsed -> STATIONARY, D_lin .017 vs D_log .428; geometric/uniform-in-log -> AGING, D_log .017 vs D_lin .572); 4 mutants from a scratch copy each red for its own reason (verdict comparison swapped · MIN_N guard removed · pre-quench guard removed · label pinned constant), and the suite also asserts the two KS distances SWAP ORDER between fixtures so neither can be unused-but-look-tracking. SCOPE: read-only, never touches m̂/regime/alarm/board, on-demand, NOT cron-wired, not in the default banner.
